boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UNL Libraries study environments, spanning quiet reading, open seating, computers, and collaboration.

cards.title: Set up at the Love Library Mezzanine
cards.subtitle: Love South, Level 2
cards.notes: Bring a laptop and choose between couches, high-tops, or desk tabletops; power outlets are available throughout the mezzanine.
cards.short_summary: A daylight-equipped mix of lounge and tabletop seating in Love South.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists the Love Library Mezzanine as an open study space with varied seating, high-top and desk tabletops, natural lighting, and power outlets.
cards.access_notes: Listed as open study space; check the linked location-hours information before visiting.

cards.title: Work among the Love Library stacks
cards.subtitle: Love South, basement/lower level through Level 3A
cards.notes: Use the movable desks and chairs to make a focused setup; most stack seating areas have window light and nearby outlets.
cards.short_summary: Eight levels of stack-side study seating with movable furniture.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries identifies the Love Library Stacks as open and designated quiet study space with movable desktops, padded seating, lighting, whiteboards, and outlets.
cards.access_notes: Listed as an open study space and designated quiet area; check location hours before visiting.

cards.title: Choose a wooden chair in Room 218
cards.subtitle: Love South, Level 2
cards.notes: Head to Room 218 for natural light, movable tables and chairs, whiteboards, and wall power when a quieter setting helps.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet reading room with flexible furniture and daylight.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists Quiet Reading Room 218 with natural lighting, movable tabletops and chairs, movable whiteboards, and wall power outlets.
cards.access_notes: Listed under Love Library open study spaces and designated quiet spaces; check location hours before visiting.

cards.title: Move your group into Love’s Collaboration Space
cards.subtitle: Love South, Level 2
cards.notes: Use the open seating and wall power for an informal work session; this location is designated for collaborative study rather than silence.
cards.short_summary: An open, collaborative setting on Love South’s second level.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists the Love Library Collaboration Space as an active study space with open seating options and wall power outlets.
cards.access_notes: Listed as an open active-study space; check location hours before visiting.

cards.title: Plug into the Love LINK computer stations
cards.subtitle: Love LINK, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Use a desktop station or connect a laptop to a monitor with HDMI; the surrounding Love LINK seating also has natural light.
cards.short_summary: A named computer-station area for desktop work or external-monitor setups.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists Love LINK Computer Stations with desktop computers and monitors with HDMI cords for laptop connection.
cards.access_notes: Listed under Love Library open study spaces; check location hours and computer availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Adele Hall Learning Commons Quiet Reading Room
cards.title: Read quietly in Adele Hall’s southwest corner
cards.subtitle: Adele Hall Learning Commons, Love North Level 1
cards.notes: Take a seat in the southwest-corner reading room, where stationary and movable seating and power outlets support longer sessions.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet reading room inside Adele Hall Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries describes the Adele Hall Quiet Reading Room as having stationary and movable seating, quiet conditions, and power outlets throughout.
cards.source_title: Adele Hall Learning Commons Study Spaces | Libraries | Nebraska
cards.access_notes: Listed as open study space; it is quiet but not soundproof. Check location hours before visiting.

cards.title: Reserve Adele Hall Room 119 for a larger group
cards.subtitle: Adele Hall Learning Commons
cards.notes: Reserve this 10-person room when your group needs a screen, HDMI connection, wireless sharing, whiteboards, and power outlets.
cards.short_summary: A documented reservable room built for a larger project group.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists Adele Hall Room 119 as a reservable 10-person study room with a flat-panel screen, HDMI, wireless sharing, whiteboards, and outlets.
cards.source_title: Adele Hall Learning Commons Study Spaces | Libraries | Nebraska
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; UNL Libraries directs users to its study-room reservation system. Room is quiet but not soundproof.

cards.entity_name: Dinsdale Family Learning Commons Quiet Study Space
cards.title: Use the Dinsdale quiet-study pods
cards.subtitle: Dinsdale Family Learning Commons, northwest corner lower level
cards.notes: Settle into a study pod with a footrest and power outlet in the lower-level northwest corner when you need an individual setup.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level pod area explicitly designated for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists Dinsdale’s northwest-corner lower-level Quiet Study Space with study pods, foot rests, and power outlets.
cards.source_title: Dinsdale Family Learning Commons Study Spaces | Libraries | Nebraska
cards.access_notes: Listed as open quiet-study space; check the linked location-hours information before visiting.

cards.title: Reserve the Heuermann Study Room
cards.subtitle: Dinsdale Family Learning Commons, Room 111
cards.notes: Book Room 111 for up to six people when you need a whiteboard, flat-panel screen, HDMI, wireless sharing, and a power tower.
cards.short_summary: A named six-person reservable room at Dinsdale.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists Heuermann Study Room 111 as a six-person reservable room with a whiteboard, flat-panel screen, HDMI, wireless sharing, and power outlet tower.
cards.source_title: Dinsdale Family Learning Commons Study Spaces | Libraries | Nebraska
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; UNL Libraries directs users to its study-room reservation system. Room is quiet but not soundproof.

cards.title: Set up in the Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: Architecture Hall, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Use the first-floor seating and outlets for independent work, or reserve a room when your group needs whiteboards and screen sharing.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor library study area with open, collaborative, and reservable options.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists Architecture Library first-floor open study spaces with varied seating and outlets, plus reservable rooms with whiteboards, screens, HDMI, wireless sharing, and natural lighting.
cards.source_title: Architecture Library Study Spaces | Libraries | Nebraska
cards.access_notes: Open and reservable options are listed; reservable rooms require using the Libraries study-room reservation system. Check location hours before visiting.
